fields.Name: workqueue
fields.Description: Parent scope for the durable work queue.

fields.Name: publish
fields.Description: Publish messages to externally publishable topics through POST /work-queue/topics/{topic}/messages. Resource: topic name.

fields.Name: read
fields.Description: Read subscription statistics, dead letters, partitions and binding validation through the WorkQueue remote operations. Resource: subscription name.

fields.Name: operate
fields.Description: Replay, discard or cancel deliveries through the WorkQueue remote operations. Resource: subscription name.
